name: flash-attention
description: Use when the user asks about FlashAttention, flash_attn, SDPA, scaled_dot_product_attention backends, online softmax, FA2/FA3/FA4 or attention OOM at long context. Produces the right exact-attention path, config and a check that the flash kernel really runs. Not for KV-cache paging in serving (use paged-attention) or custom kernels (use triton-kernels).
